edits:
Before closing this delivery, retain the **WW07 deployable-build and uncertain-accounting follow-up**, **WW11 private-subject reauthorization defect and sustained load/financial-history/assistive-device qualification**, and [existing deferred automated cases](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md#deferred-automated-coverage-routing). Paid-task exposure is recorded in [final acceptance](verification/invention-questions.md#final-acceptance--september-29); merging or deleting the chat does not release unknown charges or reset its ceiling. The committed reports are the durable handoff; temporary databases, traces and build directories are not required continuation inputs and must not be assumed to survive.
Follow current [AGENTS](../AGENTS.md) and its routed skills/policies. The original integration's merge choice and later authorized rebase are recorded in their plans; neither overrides a new task's explicit branch instructions. Use the current developer's Git, commit-cadence, per-file checkpoint and verification instructions; this handoff does not revoke them or turn an earlier integration's procedure into standing authorization. Historical reconstruction data remains in `.integration/recovery/`; its obsolete executable workflows were removed.
